relationship: admin_ai_configs is a flat key-value store config_key→config_value. admin_ai_model_configs stores per-model config with provider, endpoint, keys. There is NO foreign key relationship between the two tables — they are independent. admin_ai_configs keys (ocr_strategy_*, completion_*) are loaded by pipeline_orchestrator and question_ai_complete via get_all_configs(). admin_ai_model_configs is queried by model_config_resolver.resolve_active_model() for per-feature model resolution.
